set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Summaries use stable online algorithms and compensated aggregation where material.
- Histogram closure and density normalization tolerances are documented.
- Contour ambiguity/topology policies have property tests and independent fixtures.
- KDE exposes a tested direct/FFT strategy boundary before adding dependencies.
set.title: [Intaglio 1.0][Assurance] Define and test numerical kernel standards
